snippet.title: Dead Turn Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Dead Turn is an upcoming psychological survival horror video game.

Watch the Official Reveal Trailer and take your first look at the world of Dead Turn.

A playable demo is planned for release soon.

Wishlist Dead Turn on Steam now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4810960/Dead_Turn/

Website: https://deadturn.com/

Follow for updates and future announcements.
